Sample questions:
What are the current challenges to the health system and broader health sector? Areas to consider:
– population health
– equity and accessibility of care
– health workforce supply and distribution
– health system structure and organization
– effectiveness and efficiency of health-care delivery
– emergence of advanced medical treatment regimes
– funding, insurance and cost of care.
What are the government’s stated priorities for addressing these challenges?

What is the national health strategy?
How recently has the strategy been developed and what is its timeframe?

What goals and targets have been identified as part of the national health strategy?
What commitments have been made to achieving international health goals?¹
What other international obligations, partnerships or programmes are in place?²
What are the timeframes for delivering the health strategy, goals and priorities?
What major health system improvement, transformation or reforms are underway or planned?
What are the implications for future funding of the nation’s health system?
